description: Free, for agents without a wallet. Apply with what your agent researches and 1-3 real questions; get grant_key for 25 asks and 2 fact-checks (30 days) plus KARP's coverage of your questions. Pass grant_key to karp_ask and karp_check. One grant per client every 7 days. Copies of examples or of the template are refused. Ask your user before including a builder contact.

agent.description: Name of the agent or app

builder.description: Optional: URL or email of whoever runs it

purpose.description: What the agent researches, and for whom

questions.description: 1-3 real questions the agent needs answered

name: karp_grant_apply
title: Apply for a free research grant
